target_customer: Fashion brands, small businesses, independent designers and schools needing patterns and tech packs
problem: Fashion design and pattern development is manual and slow; Tailornova generated made to measure patterns online.
business_model: Software subscription (freemium at Tailornova, B2B platform at PatternFast)
product_category: AI fashion design and pattern software

founders.name: Yuliya Raquel
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers

technical_complexity.rationale: Parametric pattern generation with 3D preview in the browser; standard engineering with some geometry hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Pattern software markets had established CAD vendors and the product was described as patent pending only.

market_need_then: No dated source on demand near the 2019 batch was found; the Tailornova site offered free online made to measure patterns, suggesting demand among home sewers and indie designers.

branding.name_origin: Tailornova and Couturme names unexplained; PatternFast is a descriptive coinage; no source states origins

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC lists PatternFast as the later name

brand_strength.rationale: Multiple names across the company life with no brand press found.

pivots.from: Tailornova consumer and indie 3D pattern software
pivots.to: PatternFast, AI product engineering for brands
pivots.why: Not stated; Dealroom lists a 2024 founding for PatternFast

outcome_analysis: The company stayed small: Tailornova said it was self funded by the founders, then a reported $500K seed came in May 2025 for the PatternFast relaunch. Team sizes of 9 to 23 appear in listings. No exit or shutdown found; limited public evidence means the stall or growth story is unclear.
notes: Seed $500K May 2025 is reported by DevCuration, FundedIQ and VCBacked; Dealroom shows $125K (conflict). Lead investor unknown. Tailornova about page says self funded. Competitors empty: no dated source near 2019 found. Co-founders ('co-founders' on about page) not named. Downgraded to depth 1 by orchestrator: the researcher reported combining the outcome and branding searches.
